title: Cameron Highlands vs Fraser's Hill: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Cameron Highlands for first-timers and tea lovers. Fraser's Hill for birdwatchers, serious hikers, and crowd-avoiders.

categories.name: Tea Plantations
categories.summary: Cameron Highlands has BOH Sungei Palas and Bharat Estate. Fraser's Hill has none.

categories.name: Birdwatching
categories.summary: Fraser's Hill hosts the annual International Bird Race and 270+ species.

categories.name: Hiking Quality
categories.summary: Fraser's Hill trails are well-maintained and free. Cameron Highlands trails have closures and paid guided tours.

categories.name: Crowds
categories.summary: Fraser's Hill is rarely crowded. Cameron Highlands is heavily crowded on weekends and holidays.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Tanah Rata has proper hawker food and cafes. Fraser's Hill has very limited dining.

categories.name: Colonial Atmosphere
categories.summary: Fraser's Hill has intact colonial bungalows and clock tower. Cameron Highlands has been overdeveloped.

faq.question: Is Cameron Highlands or Fraser's Hill better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Cameron Highlands — more accessible, more activities, bus service from KL.

faq.question: Which has better hiking?
faq.answer: Fraser's Hill — well-maintained, clearly marked trails, all free.
